You will join an autonomous Agile team and work closely with the Product Owner, Agile Delivery Lead, Automation Testers, and other Software Engineers to create a competitive advantage for Kaizen and offer a unique online experience to our customers. Besides being part of the Agile team, you will work closely with talented backend professionals within the Backend Chapter.

As a Senior Software Engineer you will:

  • Assume full responsibility for our applications on an engaging development journey.
  • Create new solutions and see them through, from conception to production.

  • Challenge the status quo and improve the team and product.

Most of our sites and services are written in C# / ASP.NET and new services are written in .NET Core. New applications use vue.js or Angular in the front-end while older ones use server-rendered (Razor) views in combination with jQuery. Microsoft Orleans enables our scalable and robust distributed applications. MS SQL Server is used for most of our storage needs, but also Redis and ElasticSearch are used when it makes sense to do so. RabbitMQ is our go-to message broker. We use Gitlab for code versioning and CI, and the Atlassian stack for tickets and documentation.

What you'll bring:

  • Proficient in C# and MVC.
  • Experience with Testing/Metrics Monitoring/Logging on a large scale distributed system.
  • Experience with Microservices architecture.

  • Good understanding of basic web technologies, such as HTTP, REST, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of algorithms and design patterns.
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality code.
  • Fluent in English, both oral and written.

Nice to have:

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Quality Engineer at Tractian, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the highest quality standards for our hardware products and solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure that our products meet rigorous quality requirements and exceed customer expectations. Additionally, you will be responsible for identifying and collaborating with suppliers who share our commitment to excellence, further enhancing our supply chain efficiency and ensuring the consistent quality of the materials used in our products. Your expertise will contribute significantly to our mission of delivering exceptional IIoT solutions to industries worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the design and manufacturing teams to define quality standards, specifications, and inspection criteria for mechanical components and assemblies.
  • Conduct thorough quality assessments of incoming materials, ensuring they meet specified requirements and are free from defects.
  • Develop and implement quality control processes, including inspection plans, testing procedures, and relevant documentation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for any quality issues identified during testing or production, and track these actions to closure.
  • Participate in the design review process to provide insights on potential quality concerns and ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA).
  • Conduct regular audits of manufacturing processes to identify opportunities for improvement and ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve component quality, resolve quality-related issues, and drive continuous improvement in the supply chain.
  • Work closely with the production team to support process validation and ensure consistency in manufacturing processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of quality assurance activities, including test results, inspection reports, and non-conformance documentation.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of quality documentation, including standard operating procedures, work instructions, and quality manuals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Quality Engineer, preferably in a manufacturing or technology-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Familiarity in quality tools, methodologies, and documentation such as 8D, DMAIC, NCR, EA, and statistical process control.
  • Experience with inspection techniques, metrology, GD&T, and non-destructive testing methods.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead root cause analysis investigations.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or other quality management systems is a plus.
  • Reading and Writing English proficiency.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with microcasting and sintering.
  • Experience with plastic injection and mold manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of Reliability Engineering and its tools.
  • Spanish proficiency.

Se você busca desafios, aprendizado contínuo e um ambiente que valoriza a inovação, essa pode ser a oportunidade certa para você!

Key job responsibilities

  1. Estar presencialmente na estação de coleta. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, podendo incluir finais de semana e feriados.
  2. Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança em sua área de trabalho.
  3. Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  4. Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com as diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.
  5. Fornecimento contínuo de informações críticas relacionadas ao turno aos operadores.

  8. Conduzir reuniões, atribuir funções e atender aos KPIs operacionais como liberação de veículos no horário, produtividade dos associados e sucesso na coleta no primeiro dia (On Time Dispatch, TPH, First Day Pickup Success).
  9. Insistir nos mais altos padrões de qualidade e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente e impulsionar melhorias.
  10. Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade.
  11. Fornecer suporte diário durante o lançamento / implementação de sistemas / processos.
  12. Garantir que os associados tenham ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  13. Comunicar as métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos em Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

title: Hardware Test Engineer - Mechanics
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What will you do

As a Hardware Test Engineer specializing in Mechanics, your primary role will involve conducting rigorous mechanical testing and validation on a variety of hardware products. You will be hands-on in the lab, applying principles of mechanics to assess durability, lifespan, and functionality, ensuring all mechanical components operate effectively under specified conditions and comply with all regulatory standards.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute detailed mechanical test plans, including stress tests, vibration tests, and thermal cycling to evaluate product endurance.
  • Use precision measuring instruments such as calipers, micrometers, and force gauges to gather accurate test data.
  • Simulate real-world mechanical stresses using test rigs, hydraulic actuators, and environmental chambers.
  • Analyze test results, identify mechanical failures, and collaborate with design engineers to recommend product improvements.
  • Maintain meticulous documentation of all testing procedures, results, and insights for future reference and compliance purposes.
  • Ensure all mechanical testing equipment is calibrated, maintained, and operating correctly.
  • Stay up-to-date with the mechanical testing methodologies and industry best practices.
,

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in a mechanical testing environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of mechanical systems, materials properties, and manufacturing processes.
  • Proficiency in CAD software, such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD, for reviewing mechanical designs.
  • Experience with scripting languages, like Python and MATLAB.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis software like Excel.
  • Familiarity with industry standards for mechanical testing and compliance.
,

Bonus Points

  • Advanced certifications in mechanical testing or material science.
  • Experience with automated testing systems and robotic testing equipment.
  • Fluent in English.

About the role

We are seeking a skilled and go-getter Sr. Machine Learning Engineer to join our Data Science team and play a pivotal role in driving the model development/production lifecycle. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, MLOps, and DataOps teams to implement ML models for assessing transactional risk and fraud, enable automated model retraining, and support robust machine learning inference systems.   • Model Development and Optimization: Design the data-architecture flow for the efficient implementation of real-time model endpoints and/or batch solutions.

  • Monitoring, Maintenance & Improvement: Implement systems to monitor model performance, endpoints/feature health, and other business metrics; Create model-retraining pipelines to boost performance, based on monitoring metrics; Model recalibration.
  • Scalable System Design: Design and implement scalable architectures to support real-time/batch solutions; Optimize algorithms and workflows for latency, throughput, and resource efficiency; Ensure systems adhere to company standards for reliability and security.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Conduct research and prototypes to explore novel approaches in ML engineering for addressing emerging risk/fraud patterns.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with fraud analysts, risk managers, and product teams to translate business requirements into ML solutions.

Who you are:

  • Solid experience in DS/ML engineering.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing batch and real-time streaming pipelines, using SQL and NoSQL database solutions.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools for data pipelines, streaming systems, and model performance.
  • Experience in AWS cloud services (Sagemaker, EC2, EMR, ECS/EKS, RDS, etc.).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation), and MLOps platforms like MLflow.
  • Experience with Machine Learning modeling, notably tree-based and boosting models supervised learning for imbalanced target scenarios.
  • Experience with Online Inference, APIs, and services that respond under tight time constraints.
  • Proficiency in English.

title: Account Manager, Global Selling DSR (Direct Seller Recruiting), Amazon Global Selling
description:
Account Manager, Global Selling DSR (Direct Seller Recruiting), Amazon Global Selling

Are you looking for a challenging career in business-development? Do you have prior experience and a proven track-record in delivering against targets in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Amazon is looking for a Global Selling Account Managers to join its team based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
Your role will be focused on contributing to new business acquisition (50% of the time) through hunting, specifically phone/email-based prospecting of new merchants who can bring their competitive range of products, pricing and availability to Amazon. You will also work with merchants as an account manager (50% of the time) – helping them to launch and grow their business on Amazon by ensuring they understand Amazon’s products, services, systems and tools. Lastly you will be responsible for using feedback from the merchants to identify opportunities to improve Amazon’s products, services, processes, systems and tools.
Key job responsibilities
- Identify, prospect and recruit high-potential merchants via phone or email
- Effectively prioritize and manage a pipeline of merchants to consistently meet/exceed quarterly targets
- Be a business partner for new merchants providing them with data-driven insights and advice to optimize their success on Amazon
- Work closely with new merchants, educating them about Amazon’s high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience
- Enable merchants to learn and master Amazon's tools and systems so they may become self-sufficient in managing their catalog, inventory and performance efficiently and to the required standards
- Learn and understand the specificities of your categories to spot trends, seasonal items and competitive pricing to best tailor your pitch and advice to merchants
- Track and report business development results, analyze, interpret reports and information for your portfolio of merchants
- Prioritize your time optimally to achieve your targets in a KPI-driven environment
A day in the life
A typical day begins with reviewing performance metrics and pipeline status before diving into proactive outreach to potential merchants. Throughout the morning, you'll conduct virtual meetings with new sellers, providing comprehensive onboarding support and guidance through Amazon's Seller Central platform. The afternoon focuses on analyzing merchant data, conducting business reviews, and offering strategic recommendations for growth. You'll continuously monitor category trends, evaluate competitive pricing, and ensure merchants maintain Amazon's high standards for delivery and customer experience. The day involves balancing reactive support with proactive business development, all while tracking progress against quarterly targets and updating necessary reports in the CRM system. Participation in external events may apply.
About the team
Our dynamic, multicultural team is dedicated to expanding Amazon's global marketplace by enabling merchants worldwide to reach international customers. Operating at the intersection of technology and international commerce, we help businesses navigate multiple marketplaces, local regulations, and cultural nuances. Our team combines diverse perspectives from professionals across different regions and languages, working together to break down cross-border selling barriers. We pride ourselves on our data-driven approach, entrepreneurial spirit, and commitment to merchant success. Join us in shaping the future of global e-commerce while maintaining Amazon's customer-centric focus.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience prospecting, qualifying, and cold-calling companies
- Experience in procurement, negotiation, sales, consulting, supply chain, product/project management, or marketing
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools
- Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals
- Experience within e-commerce or Retail fields

title: Associate Dean Dentistry – Expat
description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?

Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB’s beautiful campus attracts students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

This position will report directly to the Dean of the College of Dentistry .

Job Description

AUIB seeks a strategic, collaborative, values-driven leader to serve as the Associate Dean of the College of Dentistry. The Associate Dean will have an ambitious vision for AUIB Dentistry that harnesses talent, creativity, and diversity. The Associate Dean will support the dean, who is the administrative and educational head of the College of Dentistry.

This Position Will Be Responsible For

  • Recruiting and retaining the college’s clinical faculty and staff in response to programmatic needs and encouraging their professional development.
  • In consultation with the chairs and directors of the concerned departments and divisions and appropriate committees, as specified in the policies, recommend to the college dean the appointment, tenure, promotion, retention, sabbatical leave, annual salary increase and retirement actions of any faculty member and administrative officer of the college.
  • Developing the clinical component of the college’s curriculum of the College.
  • Developing clinical continuing education and post-graduate programs to develop the advanced skills of practicing dentists.
  • Securing, in consultation with the Dean, the necessary accreditation and regulatory affairs associated with the profession and practice of dentistry.
  • Establishing the necessary academic quality assurance system within the college in line with those of the university as a whole leads to programmatic accreditation.
  • Overseeing, in consultation with the Dean, the appointment of academic staff and other technical and support staff of the College.
  • Representing, in the absence of the Dean, the College at meetings of the university, professional associations, governmental agencies, and other groups.
  • Developing the college’s practice and training facilities and creating an environment that facilitates research and scholarly activity.
  • Delegating duties to appropriate individuals or groups whenever indicated.
  • Performing additional tasks as the college dean or other suitable administrative officers of the university may specify.

Required Skills/Abilities

This position requires:

  • DDS, DMD, Ph.D., or the highest professional qualification in dentistry, and be a graduate of an accredited dental school.
  • Leadership experience in relevant academic institutions or universities for at least 10 years.
  • Evidence of academic and research innovations with a track record of scholarly and professional practice leadership in the field.
  • Demonstrated success in enhancing and advancing patient care, education, and research programs.
  • Demonstrated success in securing private, corporate, and/or governmental support to advance the college’s mission.
  • Demonstrated success in managing and leading a complex organization undergoing change.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills; the ability to listen and understand the needs of faculty, staff, and students; and the ability to build strong relationships with internal and external constituents.
  • Effective decision-making and conflict resolution skills.
  • Solid understanding of dental clinical practice, procedures, and scheduling.
  • Demonstrated accomplishments in research and scholarship.
  • Operational understanding of American university educational systems.
  • Preferred experience working and living in the Middle East.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

Stellantis es uno de los líderes mundiales en la fabricación de vehículos y la prestación de servicios de movilidad sostenibles, conectados, seguros y asequibles.

La fuerza que nos impulsa es el grupo diverso y talentoso de todo el mundo que aporta su pasión y experiencia al trabajo cada día. Y aunque somos una organización verdaderamente global, seguimos profundamente arraigados en las comunidades en las que operamos y en las que vive y trabaja nuestra gente.

Estamos buscando un(a) profesional con experiencia para unirse a nuestro equipo: en una primera etapa orientado al desarrollo de la red de concesionarios oficiales de la marca y en una segunda etapa enfocado en asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales establecidos.

Principales Responsabilidades :

  • Análisis de cobertura (para definir áreas donde abrir nuevos concesionarios).
  • Análisis de desempeño (para identificar oportunidades comerciales) y solicitud de planes de acción.
  • Determinación de concesionarios con bajo rendimiento, incluyendo negociaciones de cierre.
  • Búsqueda de nuevos concesionarios.
  • Implementación de Identidad Corporativa (CI), incluyendo: solicitud de inversión para la compra de logotipos, desarrollo de proveedores locales y coordinación con arquitectos para ayudar a los concesionarios a actualizar sus instalaciones.
  • En el marco de los objetivos definidos por la marca, coordinar las actividades comerciales de VN (vehículos nuevos) de los concesionarios asignados, garantizando el cumplimiento de los objetivos cuantitativos y cualitativos del área: facturación, ventas retail, ventas online, cuota de mercado, stock de CE y su antigüedad.
  • Aseguramiento de la sostenibilidad económica y financiera del concesionario, así como el cumplimiento de estándares de calidad en VN, brindando soporte metodológico en el diagnóstico y elaboración de planes de acción para mejorar el desempeño y dar seguimiento.
  • Asegurar cumplimiento del objetivo anual de ventas (presupuesto): retail, mayorista y cuota de mercado.
  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de la política comercial anual de la marca en la red de concesionarios.
  • Educación universitaria completa. (Finanzas, Control de gestión, Marketing o afines)
  • Dominio de Excel (excluyente) y Power BI (deseable).
  • Idioma: Inglés intermedio / avanzado.
  • Capacidad para liderar personas con perfiles diversos y armado de estrategias comerciales.
  • Conocimiento del mercado automotor, del producto y del negocio del concesionario.
  • Formación en marketing y ventas.

Experiencia requerida

  • Experiencia previa en ventas, marketing, servicios, finanzas, posventa, atención al cliente, calidad u operaciones comerciales de al menos 2 a 3 años .
  • Conocimiento sólido del negocio automotor.

Perfil Buscado:

  • Orientado a la resolución de problemas
  • Capacidad de adaptación a un entorno cambiante
  • Disposición a trabajar en equipo
  • Autonomía
  • Habilidades para hablar en público (ante audiencias pequeñas y grandes).
  • Capacidad de negociación.
  • Orientación a resultados
  • Enfoque en el cliente

En Stellantis, evaluamos a los candidatos según sus méritos, calificación y necesidades del negocio. Damos la bienvenida a solicitudes de personas de todas las identidades de género, edad, etnia, nacionalidad, religión, orientación sexual y a personas con discapacidad. Los equipos diversos nos permitirán satisfacer mejor las necesidades emergentes de nuestros clientes y cuidar nuestro futuro.

Modalidad de trabajo: Híbrido.

Localidad: Buenos Aires

Horario: 8 a 17hs / 9 a 18hs

description:
Vem ser Ituber & vem fazer Itaú_

O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 60 milhões de clientes em 18 países. Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um quadro com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças. Não queremos você apenas por achar que tem a nossa cara. Queremos ter um pouco da sua também!


Como é o dia a dia de um Ituber nessa área?

Você será parte essencial da nossa equipe de Recuperação, trazendo a postura e experiência de um profissional Sênior para nos ajudar a identificar e implementar inovações que auxiliem clientes endividados a se organizarem financeiramente e a restaurarem a confiança no Itaú como seu banco principal.

Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Mapear jornadas de produtos de Recuperação em diversos canais, identificando dores e oportunidades de melhoria, além de definir e revisar as propostas de valor dos serviços.
  • Compreender profundamente o cliente por meio de pesquisas conduzidas pelo nosso time de Research.
  • Participar e apoiar discussões estratégicas de negócio e definição de indicadores, garantindo que a visão do cliente seja sempre considerada.
  • Atualizar e difundir a jornada do cliente, transformando-a no repositório central de conhecimento da área.
  • Propor e estruturar testes baseados nas dores e oportunidades identificadas, acompanhando sua implementação e impacto nos indicadores de negócio e satisfação do cliente.
  • Gerenciar expectativas de pares de Produto e Tecnologia, definindo prazos e escopos de atividades em conjunto, e posicionando-se como referência na escolha dos métodos, processos e qualidade das entregas.

No que você precisa mandar bem?

  • Experiência com Design de Serviço e/ou Engenharia de Processos,
  • Mapeamento de jornada do cliente.
  • Blueprint de serviço.
  • Dinâmicas de cocriação.
  • Estruturação de briefings de pesquisa.
  • Estruturação de testes e mensuração de impactos qualitativos e quantitativos.
  • Benchmark de concorrentes diretos e cenários análogos.
  • Domínio do discovery e definição de propostas de valor.
  • Experiência com estratégia e indicadores de negócio.
  • Tecnologia: Miro , Figma , Figjam

description:
O Grupo Data é uma empresa líder em tecnologia sediada em São Paulo, Brasil. Somos especializados em fornecer soluções inovadoras para empresas de todos os tamanhos, ajudando a melhorar suas operações e atingir seus objetivos. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais altamente especializados e motivados, apaixonados por oferecer um serviço excepcional aos nossos clientes.


Atualmente, estamos buscando um Consultor SAP Business One para se juntar à nossa equipe em tempo integral e permanente. Nesta função, você será responsável por implementar e dar suporte às soluções SAP Business One para nossos clientes. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com nossos clientes para entender suas necessidades de negócios e fornecer soluções personalizadas que atendam aos seus requisitos.


As principais responsabilidades da função incluem:

  1. Implementar e configurar o SAP Business One de acordo com os requisitos do cliente.

  3. Forte compreensão dos módulos e funcionalidades do SAP Business One.

description:

Designer Sênior (Foco em Performance e Engajamento)

Sobre nós

Sobre nós

A Agroadvance é a Escola de Negócios Agro que conecta o campo à cidade, amplificando os resultados do agronegócio no Brasil e destacando a cultura e o valor do setor.

Na Agroadvance, temos o objetivo de fazer profissionais e produtores do agronegócio ganharem Prosperidade e Prestígio além do que imaginavam ser possível, para serem reconhecidos como heróis nacionais.

Nós encurtamos as distâncias do aprendizado para que as pessoas CRESÇAM e ORGULHEM-SE de sua jornada no AGRO.

Quem buscamos?

A AgroAdvance, líder no setor de educação agrícola, busca uma pessoa criativa, estratégica e orientada a resultados, que entenda que design é muito mais que estética — é uma ferramenta poderosa para gerar engajamento e performance. Procuramos alguém com olhar analítico, que acompanhe tendências, goste de testar, aprender com dados e evoluir continuamente. Esperamos uma pessoa colaborativa, com escuta ativa, capaz de transformar ideias em peças visuais impactantes e coerentes com a identidade da marca, sempre em sinergia com o time.

Suas responsabilidades:

  • Criar conteúdos visuais para redes sociais, campanhas de mídia paga, e outras frentes digitais com foco em impacto e conversão.
  • Desenvolver peças que otimizem o engajamento do público, baseando decisões criativas em dados e testes.
  • Garantir coerência visual com a identidade da marca em todos os canais e campanhas.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os times de social media, conteúdo e performance para garantir alinhamento às estratégias.
  • Participar de brainstormings criativos, contribuindo com soluções visuais relevantes e originais.
  • Acompanhar resultados de campanhas em mídia paga e propor melhorias com base nos aprendizados.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Domínio do pacote Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere).
  • Experiência com design para social media, mídia paga (Meta Ads, Google Ads) e campanhas digitais.
  • Conhecimento de formatos, proporções e melhores práticas para plataformas como Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, entre outras.
  • Familiaridade com testes A/B de criativos e interpretação de métricas básicas de performance (CTR, CPM, ROAS, engajamento).
  • Desejável: habilidades básicas em motion design, edição de vídeo e ferramentas como Figma ou Canva Pro.
  • Conhecimento avançado em edição de vídeo.
  • Diferencial: conhecimento em animação e motion design, com habilidade para criar peças animadas que elevem a performance criativa.

Quem Queremos no Time (Soft Skills):

Buscamos alguém com mentalidade de dono, comprometido com resultados, que una criatividade com estratégia, pensando no impacto de cada peça visual nos objetivos da marca. Uma pessoa colaborativa, que saiba ouvir, construir junto e se comunique bem com diferentes áreas.

Se você possui essas qualificações, inscreva-se e venha fazer parte do nosso time, levando educação de qualidade por todo o Brasil.

description:
The Property Specialist, Senior

The Property Specialist, Senior will be based at one of three Amentum sites in Iraq and serve the Operations and Maintenance Support Services (OMSS) contract in support of the U.S. Department of State. This position, under general supervision, will ensure that Government property is properly identified and tracked from acquisition to disposition. This position collaborates with and reports to the Logistics Manager to schedule and resolve inventory discrepancies. The duties and responsibilities listed below are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all inclusive.

DUTIES:

  1. Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  2. Comply with all Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements and goals.
  3. Provide information and materials to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  4. Ensure that property records are accessible and appropriately controlled and maintained consistent with the nature of the business, property type, applicable policies and procedures, and customer requirements.
  5. Minimize administrative cost by using common processes when possible.
  6. Develop and execute plans to inventory accountable property. The frequency and method of inventory may vary based on property type and established practices.
  7. Ensure that subcontract agreements address property to be furnished to or acquired by subcontractors or other elements and include appropriate property management requirements.
  8. Assess subcontractor property control systems to provide reasonable assurance that accountable property is managed in accordance with subcontract terms and conditions.
  9. Administer and manage physical inventories of Government Property.
  10. Work closely with lower-level Property Staff and Property Custodians to ensure overall accountability of assets.
  11. Mentor lower-level Property Staff and custodians in proper process and procedures as they relate to Government Property.
  12. Identify problem areas and recommend viable solutions.
  13. Perform physical inventories of Government Furnished Property (GFP) and Contractor Acquired Property (CAP), as directed by the Logistics and Property Manager.
  14. Assign Government Property Identification numbers (GP), prepare required schedule, and assist with identifying Lost, Damaged, & Destroyed property as well as excessive consumption.
  15. Track and record movement of all types of Government property. This includes movement from one point to another within a contractor’s facility, movement between facilities, for any purpose, and protection during movement.
  16. Assist on the preparation and safeguarding of administrative support files.
  17. Prepare hand receipts for all property custodian/hand receipt holders.
  18. Ensure compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Statement of Work (SOW) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
  19. Complete routine spot checks of site assets.
  20. Maintain logs and status records to include lost, damaged, or destroyed items.
  21. Check LTDD packages for accuracy and completion.
  22. Assist with all other Logistics Warehouse duties as assigned.

REQUIRED:

  1. Minimum Acceptable Experience Level: Background in property and/or materials management.
  2. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
  3. Knowledge of the FAR and industry leading practices regarding Government Property.
  4. Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions and decimals.
  5. Collect data, define problems, and propose solutions.
  6. Understand how inventory affects company contractual obligations.
  7. Ability to clearly and concisely articulate services/requirements in writing.
  8. Ability to articulate in a clear and concise manner with Management and Trades Departments on a daily basis.
  9. Ability to lift materials and equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
  10. Ability to demonstrate analytical skills, researching skills.
  11. Ability to efficiently and effectively perform the technical requirements.
  12. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with ability to prioritize effectively and work with a sense of urgency.
  13. Ability to read, interpret and follow all Amentum /Logistic Management procedures, policies and guidelines.
  14. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions.
  15. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment that requires handling multiple tasks at a given time and rapidly adapting to changing priorities and schedules.
  16. Education: A high school diploma or GED. An undergraduate degree is preferred but can be replaced with additional years of Government Property Administration.
  17. Passport, Licenses and Certifications: As part of pre-contingency requirements, by the time the visa process starts, candidates must possess a valid passport with a minimum of 18 months remaining to expiration date with 8 blank pages. Valid drivers’ license from Home of Record.
  18. Security Vetting: Already possess a Moderate Risk Public Trust (MRPT) or be able to obtain a favorable MRPT certification prior to being hired is required for the position. Must maintain eligibility at the required certification level for the duration of the contract.
  19. Language Skills: Satisfactory English proficiency to meet job requirements and to adhere and comply with safety, health, and security measures.
  20. Medical: Successfully complete and pass the medical and dental examinations as required by Amentum and our customer for deployment to Iraq. Must maintain physical and dental requirements for duration of deployment.

DESIRED:

  1. Previous out of home country experience is highly desirable and previous work experience in harsh environmental conditions is a plus.
  2. Experience working with Amentum /PAE.

OTHER KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  1. Knowledge of ALL principles and processes involved in operating and supporting supply chain functions at a large-scale overseas facility.
  2. Experience providing excellent customer services.
  3. Cross-cultural sensitivity with an international perspective.
  4. Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  5. Expert computer skills, specifically in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  6. Ability to become an active and functioning member of a team.
  7. Must have the ability to be innovative and be an agent for change.
  8. Expert communication skills to facilitate and disseminate information.

description:
Who we are:

We are a leader in fraud prevention and AML compliance. Our platform uses device intelligence, behavior biometrics, machine learning, and AI to stop fraud before it happens. Today, over 300 banks, retailers, and fintechs worldwide use Sardine to stop identity fraud, payment fraud, account takeovers, and social engineering scams. We have raised $145M from world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Activant, Visa, Experian, FIS, and Google Ventures.

Our culture:

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, and Toronto. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

Location: Remote - Brazil. To be considered for this position, you must reside in one of the following cities:

  • São Paulo: São Paulo, Campinas, São José dos Campos

  • Rio de Janeiro: Rio de Janeiro

  • Minas Gerais: Belo Horizonte

  • Paraná: Curitiba

  • Santa Catarina: Florianópolis

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on QA Engineering Lead to shape and scale Sardine’s end-to-end quality function - spanning automation, manual testing, frameworks, and strategy. You’ll lead a growing team of QA engineers while also contributing technically to ensure our products are robust, scalable, and reliable. This is a 70% IC and 30% management role.

This high-impact, cross-functional role involves close collaboration with Product, Sales, and Engineering. This role is ideally suited for someone who thrives in a high-ownership environment, is motivated to build scalable systems, and wants to shape the quality function from the ground up.

What you’ll be doing

70% IC Scope + 30% Manager

  • Own and evolve the QA function across our products, including test framework, test automation, manual QA practices, and continuous integration

  • Build a robust, scalable, and maintainable automated test framework for backend APIs and frontend applications

  • Develop test plans, cases, and data strategies for complex features across distributed systems.

  • Partner with engineers to shift testing left and embed quality into the dev lifecycle

  • Partner with DevOps and Engineering to embed quality gates into our CI/CD and release pipelines

  • Establish and track quality KPIs such as defect density, regression rates, and test coverage.

  • Promote a culture of quality and champion QA best practices across the organization.
    Lead and mentor QA engineers while contributing hands-on to test development.

What you’ll bring

  • 6+ years of experience in QA or software engineering roles with a strong testing focus, ideally in high-growth startup environments

  • 2+ years of formal management or team lead experience, including mentoring QA engineers

  • Experience working with distributed or international teams

  • Expertise in building end-to-end test automation for APIs, web frontend and mobile SDKs

  • Proficiency with modern test frameworks (e.g., Cypress, Selenium, Playwright)

  • Comfort writing tests in languages like Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript

  • Solid understanding of CI/CD workflows and how to integrate automated tests

  • Strong communicator with a bias toward action, ownership, and continuous improvement

Compensation: Base pay range of 360,000 – 455,000 BRL + Series C equity with tremendous upside potential + Attractive benefits

Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Articulador Social atuará na linha de frente do projeto Rede Liderança, Oficinas e Palestras comunitárias na área de concessão da Enel SP. A função interage diretamente com os parceiros envolvidos (Associações de moradores, representantes de bairro, ONGs, grupos produtivos comunitários, instituições religiosas, universidades, instituições públicas e privadas), organizando os eventos e realizando os mesmos.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Preparação e condução das reuniões de liderança com metodologia de mediação de grupos e dinâmicas;
  2. Organização e realização de Oficinas para mulheres e Palestras comunitárias;
  3. Manter um canal de comunicação próximo e direto com os parceiros, possibilitando a melhoria da qualidade dos serviços prestados pela Enel, minimizando conflitos e gerando valor compartilhado;
  4. Criar e propor estratégias de abordagem com os grupos;
  5. Realizar visitas institucionais para identificação das lideranças comunitárias;
  6. Proceder com o mapeamento e análise dos perfis das lideranças comunitárias;
  7. Prospectar líderes comunitários para fins de aplicação de questionários;
  8. Analisar e mapear os resultados e objetivos alcançados;
  9. Identificar temas levantados pelos participantes dos grupos e propor as temáticas das reuniões;
  10. Enviar relatórios periódicos de desempenho das ações do projeto;
  11. Prospectar possíveis grupos produtivos de interesse da ENEL;
  12. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  13. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;
  14. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do setor.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers' objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:

  • Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical
  • Focus - Large companies with established ARR
  • Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers
All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers.
Location: This role will be based remotely.
What your day will look like
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers and decision makers from various industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales.
  • Experience running a disciplined, weekly customer and business review process with cross-functional teams, identifying and prioritizing blockers, and driving resolution through corporate product and engineering teams
  • Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical products roadmaps, Canonical websites, documentation, processes and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.
  • Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
What we are looking for in you
The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.
  • Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.
  • A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies.
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus!
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Lead Solution Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About the role

Taktile exists to create value for organizations through smarter and safer decisions at scale. Our goal is to become the world's leading software provider for automated decision-making in the financial services industry and, to date, our software has been used by our customers to power over 1,000,000 critical business decisions every day.

Taktile is based in Berlin, London, and New York City. We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors and show great traction with scale-ups and large enterprises across the financial services and insurance industry. We are looking to build on this success by growing our sales team, professionalizing our go-to-market, and acquiring more customers.

That’s where you come in.

As a Solution Engineer, you are core to our mission of transforming our customer's decisioning infrastructure to enable them to optimize and automate complex and mission-critical business decisions. You will work in partnership with Taktile's Sales Team and ensure our customers get value from Taktile throughout their entire lifecycle. You are a trusted advisor to our customers and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize value by using Taktile in their decisioning tech stack.

If you are passionate about state-of-the-art tech products, have gathered a few years of experience working with Python and customers, and enjoy working as part of an awesome team that empowers you to grow, then we think you'll love this job!

ABOUT YOU

  • You know how to build strong customer relationships with stakeholders across different levels of seniority, including both technical stakeholders in an organization (e.g., Principal Engineers, Data Scientists) as well as business stakeholders (e.g., Risk Managers, Credit Analysts).
  • You are curious and customer-centric. You enjoy learning about our customers’ and prospects’ businesses and helping them solve challenges.
  • You are able to plan and manage project scope, expectations, and timelines. You will need to manage multiple projects across customers that will be at different parts of their journey with Taktile.
  • You are humble and have a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new skills and methodologies and bring best practices into our business.
  • You are collaborative and work well with your peers in Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering, and the Customer Success team.
  • You are creative and proactive - you’re always looking for ways to stand out with customers and prospects.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English.

What You'll Do

  • You discover and translate customer's strategic priorities and problem statements into high-impact use cases leveraging Taktile during the sales process and throughout the entire customer value journey including adoption, expansion, and renewal.
  • You build demos, support our sales team and customers in building business cases, and design and scope proof of value projects which demonstrate the value Taktile delivers for the customer within a short amount of time.
  • You collaborate with partners and customers to design and build solutions in Taktile's Decisioning Platform.
  • You lead proof-of-value projects and can communicate the value opportunity of a full implementation and the corresponding strategic roadmap to senior stakeholders up to C-level executives.
  • You onboard and work with various of our customers' teams (domain experts, product, engineering, data science) to help them solve real-world problems. You understand people and technology, and are proficient and diligent in writing and testing Python code and committed to providing an excellent experience and fast time to value to Taktile’s customers.
  • You will work with product management to translate your knowledge of customer problems into product insights to shape Taktile's product roadmap.
  • You will create re-usable collateral, best practices & tools to help scale your knowledge and expertise across the solution engineering function.
  • You lead the discovery for new use cases and implement them on the platform to assess product-solution fit. You provide feedback to our product team and share results of your discovery with go-to-market functions.

Ideal, But Not Required

  • Live for Customer Value: You have at least 5+ years of experience working within Enterprise / "high touch" Solution Engineering, as a technical Customer Success Manager / Engineer in a B2B SaaS company or as (Technical) Senior Consultant.
  • Technical expertise: You have a general understanding of REST APIs (design, integration, authentication).
  • Data & Analytics: You have experience in applying and optimizing statistical and machine learning models to solve business problems. You are familiar with the state-of-the-art data & analytics tech stack and workflow automation platforms which help you creatively solve your customers' automation and optimization problems.
  • Business domain expertise: You have acquired domain expertise in the financial services industry (banking, insurance, capital markets, payments, etc.).

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.
  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.
  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.
  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.
  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.
  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books, or take classes.
  • Use the equipment of your choice including a meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.
  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism, and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms.

About us

Taktile is building the world's leading software platform for running critical and highly-automated decisions. Our customers use our product to catch fraudsters, prevent money laundering, and expand access to credit for small businesses, among many other use cases. Taktile is already making millions of such decisions across the globe every day.

Key responsibilities/Expectations from the Role

  • Lead the end-to-end migration from Citrix ADC to F5 BIG-IP, ensuring a smooth and efficient process.
  • Collaborate with the Engineering team to develop migration strategies and incorporate their recommendations into the project.
  • Assess existing Citrix ADC configurations, including load balancing, SSL offloading, authentication, and security policies.
  • Design and implement F5 BIG-IP architectures that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Configure and test F5 BIG-IP features such as LTM, SSL/TLS profiles, persistence, iRules, and high availability.

  • Offer post-migration support and address any issues identified during the transition phase.
  • Monitor and log network traffic to ensure proactive issue identification and resolution.

Must Have

  • Strong experience with Citrix ADC (NetScaler) and F5 BIG-IP (LTM).
  • Deep knowledge of load balancing, SSL/TLS offloading, session persistence, and traffic management.
  • Experience in high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations.
  • Familiarity with security features such as WAF, access control policies, and authentication mechanisms.
  • Proficiency in writing and troubleshooting F5 iRules.
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Good to Have

  • Ability to work closely with Engineering and Operations teams to align project strategies and incorporate feedback.
  • Excellent documentation and reporting skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Awareness of security best practices in automation and the ability to implement secure coding principles.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • F5 Certified Administrator (F5-CA) or F5 Certified Technical Specialist (F5-CTS) preferred.
  • Citrix certifications such as CCP-N (Citrix Certified Professional – Networking) are a plus.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in network engineering, with significant experience in Citrix ADC and F5 BIG-IP migration or administration.

Job description

Fundada por Mauro Piccolotto Dottori em 1982, a MPD Engenharia destaca-se no mercado da Construção Civil há mais de 40 anos. Atuamos em diversos segmentos, incluindo industrial, comercial, residencial, educacional, saúde, corporativo e lazer. Nosso compromisso é crescer com responsabilidade social, qualidade e solidez, princípios que guiam nossos planos futuros. Valorizamos a colaboração e a organização, mantendo sempre nossos valores como base para uma estratégia de negócios assertiva.

Em nossa organização, a qualidade é um valor essencial. Continuamos investindo na consolidação dos processos internos, no desenvolvimento do capital humano e na disseminação da cultura empresarial. Estamos preparados para enfrentar os desafios de um mercado em transformação, liderando mudanças e realizando empreendimentos de ponta.

A dedicação e a competência nos levaram a conquistar solidez e destaque no mercado. Os envolvidos nos projetos têm o "olhar de dono", fundamental para nossa atitude empreendedora. Essa abordagem posiciona nossa marca entre as mais conceituadas e premiadas do mercado nacional, confirmando que estamos no caminho certo.


Main responsibilities

  1. Pesquisar o mercado fornecedor de produtos e serviços, através de coleta de preços, visando identificar as melhores oportunidades de compras.
  2. Negociar com os fornecedores, visando ao fechamento de compras dentro das melhores condições de preço, qualidade e prazo de entrega.
  3. Emitir os pedidos de compra e encaminhá-los aos fornecedores, fazendo o acompanhamento do processo de entrega e cumprimento final de todas as condições negociadas.
  4. Pesquisar novos fornecedores de produtos e serviços diversos, visando desenvolver fontes alternativas de suprimentos.
  5. Pesquisar produtos alternativos, conforme as possibilidades do processo produtivo, visando melhorar a qualidade do produto e reduzir custos de produção.
  6. Fazer o acompanhamento dos pedidos, visando assegurar sua entrega no prazo estabelecido.
  7. Acompanhar o processo de devolução de mercadorias entregues em desacordo com o pedido.
  8. Atualizar as tabelas de preços de mercadorias com os fornecedores e repassando internamente a informação aos setores envolvidos.
  9. Realizar visitas às fábricas dos fornecedores, para atualização técnica em relação aos produtos comprados.
  10. Verificar qualidade e idoneidade do fabricante do produto a ser adquirido.
  11. Preparar e analisar mapas de concorrências com propostas de fornecedores.
  12. Cadastrar novos fornecedores para consultas e cotações, conforme necessário.

Observação: Mais de 8 anos de experiência, já deve ter comprado todos os itens da Curva ABC de Compras, foco em grandes valores, negociação estratégica, contratos de longo prazo, possuir muita autonomia, reporte direto à gerência e diretoria.

Join to apply for the Pessoa Analista em Arquitetura Pleno - Centro role at Farmácias Pague Menos

Job Description
Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?
Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Garantir o desenvolvimento dos projetos de novas lojas ou reformas, acompanhando a execução de maneira próxima, e atuando como um elo crucial entre a estratégia da organização e a execução dos projetos;
  • Desenvolvimento de propostas de estudos de massa, considerando aspectos arquitetônicos, funcionais e orçamentários, no processo de implantação de novas unidades e de reformas existentes;
  • Desenvolvimento de propostas de layouts ou reformas de unidades existentes, ou ainda, de novas unidades sob supervisão, considerando aspectos arquitetônicos, funcionais e orçamentários;
  • Participar dos processos de implantações de novas lojas, acompanhando todos os aspectos do projeto arquitetônico;
  • Desenvolver propostas de layout inovadores e eficientes, considerando requisitos operacionais, estéticos e ergonômicos, garantindo a otimização do espaço, eficiência operacional, e a experiência positiva ao usuário;
  • Acompanhar o projeto completo, desde a concepção até a conclusão, assegurando que os prazos e orçamentos sejam cumpridos, recebendo apoio e orientações próximas necessárias;
  • Pesquisar e implementar as melhores práticas do mercado, incorporando inovações tecnológicas e conceituais dos projetos arquitetônicos, identificando oportunidades de melhorias e implantando soluções inovadoras;
  • Desenvolvimento de apresentações para comitê de aprovações com a diretoria;
  • Compatibilização de projetos executivos de todas as disciplinas.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Graduação em Arquitetura e Urbanismo. Desejável estar cursando pós graduação ou especialização na área de atuação;
  • De 03 a 04 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de projetos de arquitetura, complementares e compatibilização entre as disciplinas;
  • Experiência com Software de design e modelagem arquitetônica;
  • Experiência com Gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Revit Intermediário, Autocad Avançado, Pacote Office Avançado.

Benefícios

  • Vale-refeição, de acordo com a convenção coletiva;
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade, localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Assistência Funeral;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;
  • Wellhub (plataforma de bem-estar que oferece opções de atividades físicas, mindfulness e outros);
  • Educa Mais (planos personalizados de graduação, pós-graduação, mentorias, cursos livres e de idiomas);
  • Sempre Bem Ouro + (plataforma que oferece acesso gratuito a psicólogos, nutricionistas e clínicos gerais por meio de telemedicina);
  • Ginástica laboral, conforme a localidade;
  • Bônus anual.

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Process stages

  • Step 1: Registration
  • Step 2: Entrevista RH
  • Step 3: Entrevista Gestor
  • Step 4: Teste de Integridade
  • Step 5: Carta Proposta
  • Step 6: Hiring

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

description:
What type of appointment are you looking for?

Night Shift, 2 shifts per week 1845-0715 every third weekend and every other holiday.

Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN) is home to nearly 23,000 colleagues who make up our talented, vibrant and diverse workforce. Join our team and experience firsthand what it's like to be part of a health care organization that's nationally recognized, forward-thinking and offers plenty of opportunity to do great work.

Imagine a career at one of the nation's most advanced health networks.

Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.

LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.

Summary

Provides professional nursing care through skillful assessment, diagnosis, outcomes identification, planning, implementation, and evaluation in accordance with facility or department policies and procedures. Directs and manages the care of designated patients. Utilizes effective and appropriate communication styles. Assists in maintaining a safe work environment and maintains clinical and professional competency as appropriate to the population of patients served.

Job Duties
  • Assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates the care for designated patients. Recognizes the need for and initiates collaboration/communication with physicians, interdisciplinary team members, and takes actions to proactively resolve patients needs.
  • Demonstrates commitment to quality and safety, in accordance with established policies and procedures, utilizing evidence-based practice. Participates in evidence-based practice and research projects as applicable.
  • Uses effective and appropriate verbal and non-verbal communication styles with patients, significant others, visitors, staff, and professional colleagues.
  • Coordinates and provides patient and family education throughout treatment course to facilitate an effective transition of care.
  • Functions as a department team member to support unit and hospital goals and objectives. Participates in all phases of the performance improvement process, including organizational and unit-based patient experience goals.
  • Performs validated technical skills based upon clinical specialty and unit practice.
  • Utilizes technology and incorporates technology to optimize alternative modes of care delivery.
  • Demonstrates leadership and team building skills including teaching and mentoring new colleagues and department interns.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Graduate of accredited Nursing program.
  • Knowledge and competence that reflects current nursing practice.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize assignments in the delivery of patient care.
  • Successful completion of additional orientation programs related to specialty.
  • Attainment and maintenance of unit-specific competencies.
  • Basic computer skills.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire.
  • RN - Licensed Registered Nurse_PA - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree Nursing.
Physical Demands

Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)

  • Travel to and staff key events as needed and appropriate.

Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or relevant field of study.
  • Minimum of seven years of experience in media relations or public relations within the technology/fintech industries, with deep knowledge of and relationships with media in related landscape.

  • Ability to manage large-scale, complex projects with discipline, speed, flexibility, adaptability and precision.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment with outstanding judgement, problem-solving ability and resourcefulness; ability to self-motivate and work independently.

Essa posição é para atuar em modelo híbrido em Contagem, MG.
Who will you be working with?
The Sr Systems Administration Engineer will work as a member of a seasoned Information Technology (IT) team.
How will you make a difference?
The Sr Systems Administration Engineer will plan, coordinate, and administer OpenShift environments for both development and customer-facing production environments that require deep hands-on development, design, and implementation with an end goal being a fully automated environment deployment using Ansible. This person will require deep, focused, and varied experience specifically with supporting production Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes environments.
What will your typical day look like?

  • Manage the container platform ecosystem (installation, upgrade, patching, monitoring).
  • Assist in change management of container platform for new versions of OpenShift, Hotfixes, SysAdmin tasks, etc.
  • Cluster capacity management and provisioning through automation of underlying hosts.
  • Provides L3 engineering support.
  • Works with experienced team members to conduct root cause analysis of issues, review new and existing code, and/or perform unit testing.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What do we want to know about you?
  • BS/BA in Computer Science or related field.
  • Experience in the Information Technology Field.
  • Industry experience working with cloud technologies and handling DevOps Functions for complex systems.
  • Experience in deploying microservices in OpenShift Cluster and Kubernetes or Docker.
  • Experience in VMware Virtualization infrastructure.
  • Experience in CI/CD Pipeline.
  • Experience in networking and understanding of network Protocols, DNS, VPN, and Load Balancing.
  • Experience in shell, python scripting
  • Must be willing to work occasional on-call weekday/weekend schedule
  • Expertise with the RedHat OpenShift Container Platform.
  • Expertise with Kubernetes.
  • Expertise in RedHat Linux administration.
  • Experience working with infrastructure as code technologies such as Terraform or Ansible.

Benefícios

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.
Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You'll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers.
As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you're able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.
The role entails

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones

  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals

  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
